<set-variable name="listBackends" value="@{
        JObject selected = (JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackends"];
        JArray backends = new JArray();
        string salt = "0123456789"; // 10-digit salt
        using (var sha = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create()) {
        foreach (var prop in selected.Properties()) {
            JObject src = (JObject)prop.Value;
            JObject backend = new JObject();

            // The property name is the backend label shown in the logs.
            backend["label"] = prop.Name;

            // Required fields.
            backend["url"] = src.Value("url") ?? "";
            backend["priorityGroup"] = src["priorityGroup"]?.Value() ?? 1;
            backend["timeout"] = (src["timeout"] != null && src["timeout"].Type != JTokenType.Null) ? src.Value("timeout") : 10;

            // Optional fields with defaults.
            backend["path"] = (src["path"] != null && src["path"].Type != JTokenType.Null) ? src.Value("path") : "openai";
            backend["auth"] = (src["auth"] != null && src["auth"].Type != JTokenType.Null) ? src.Value("auth") : "MI";
            backend["tokenProcessor"] = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(src.Value("tokenProcessor")) ? "DefaultStream" : src.Value("tokenProcessor");
            // acceptablePriorities may be a JArray ([1,2,3]) or a comma-separated string ("1,2,3").
            // Missing, empty, or fully unparsable values intentionally allow all priorities.
            JToken ap = src["acceptablePriorities"];
            JArray priorities;
            if (ap != null && ap.Type == JTokenType.Array) {
                priorities = (JArray)ap.DeepClone();
            } else if (ap != null && ap.Type == JTokenType.String) {
                priorities = new JArray();
                foreach (string part in ap.Value().Split(new[] { ',', ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)) {
                    if (int.TryParse(part.Trim(), out int p)) { priorities.Add(p); }
                }
            } else {
                priorities = new JArray();
            }
            if (priorities.Count == 0) { priorities = new JArray(1, 2, 3); }
            backend["acceptablePriorities"] = priorities;
            backend["limitConcurrency"] = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(src.Value("limitConcurrency")) ? "off" : src.Value("limitConcurrency");
            backend["bufferResponse"] = (src["bufferResponse"] != null && src["bufferResponse"].Type != JTokenType.Null) ? src["bufferResponse"].DeepClone() : true;

            // Join url + path.
            string rawUrl = (backend.Value("url") ?? "").TrimEnd('/');
            string rawPath = (backend.Value("path") ?? "").TrimStart('/');
            string joinedUrl = string.IsNullOrEmpty(rawPath) ? rawUrl : (rawUrl + "/" + rawPath);
            backend["url"] = joinedUrl;

            // Unique per-backend id: hash of url + label.
            string saltedUrl = salt + joinedUrl + prop.Name;
            backend["affinity"] = string.Concat(
                sha.ComputeHash(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(saltedUrl))
                .Take(10)
                .Select(x => x.ToString("x2"))
            );
            backend["isThrottling"] = false;
            backend["retryAfter"] = DateTime.MinValue;
            backend["defaultRetryAfter"] = 10;

            backends.Add(backend);
        }
        }
        return backends;
    }" />
